title: Fetal Growth Pattern in Short Stature Women
brief_summary: Women of short stature tend to be classified regarding fetal growth by the same criteria as women of normal and tall stature. The objective of the following study is to evaluate fetal growth patterns parallel to women's height and try to make conclusions regarding possible definitions of subjective Intra-uterine growth restriction.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women under 1.6 meters of height.
* Singleton pregnancy.
* Low risk pregnancy.
* Accurate dating.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women over 1.6 meters of height.
* Multiple pregnancy.
* High risk pregnancy.
study_population: Women of short stature under 1.6 meters.
